title: mac signal
description: Battery, Time Machine, startup-disk space (pmset / tmutil / df every 30 s) and active input minutes today (providers.mac.active, ioreg HIDIdleTime sampled every 60 s, persisted per day). GET /api/signals/mac, polled every 30 s; 404 unless providers.mac.enabled. Battery and Time Machine keys are ABSENT on machines without them, and every key except `active` may be absent right after start-up. Not sensitive.

batt_left.description: Time remaining 'h:mm' (to empty or to full), null while pmset has no estimate.

tm_running.description: True while a Time Machine backup runs.

tm_pct.description: Progress of the running backup, percent, or null when not running / unknown.

tm_last.description: End of the latest Time Machine backup. Unix time in seconds (float).

active.description: Active minutes today, or null when providers.mac.active is off / not sampled yet.

date.description: Local date 'YYYY-MM-DD' the count belongs to.

minutes.description: Minutes today with input within the previous 5 min.

idle.description: Seconds since the last keyboard/mouse input at the last sample.
